_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "diff_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "nickname" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "reg_no" TEXT NULL, "reg_no_key" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "fuel_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "business_model" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "photo_file" TEXT NULL, "purchase_date" INTEGER NULL, "purchase_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drivers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "license_no" TEXT NULL, "license_expiry" INTEGER NULL, "nid_encrypted" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "emergency_contact" TEXT NULL, "join_day" INTEGER NULL, "photo_file" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assignments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id), "driver_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drivers (id), "pay_model_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_day" INTEGER NULL, "active_vehicle_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("active_vehicle_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "driver_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drivers (id), "day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("driver_id", "day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "advances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "driver_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drivers (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "given_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payouts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "driver_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drivers (id), "assignment_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assignments (id), "period_start_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period_end_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "earned_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "adjustment_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "adjustment_note" TEXT NULL, "deducted_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "net_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "period_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("period_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payout_advance_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "payout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payouts (id), "advance_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES advances (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
